goal.vi: Gọi lại, hỏi người kia có tiện nói không, xác nhận chi tiết và kết thúc cuộc gọi lịch sự.
goal.en: Return a call, check if it's a good time, confirm details and end the call politely.

dialogue.aRole: a receptionist at a dental office
lines: Bright Smile Dental, this is Mia speaking.
Hi Mia, this is Alex. I'm returning your call from this morning. Is now a good time to talk?
Yes, thanks for calling back. We need to move your appointment on Tuesday.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Which day?
Tuesday. Could we move it to Thursday at three?
Could you hold on a second? Let me check my calendar… Yes, that works. So that's Thursday at three, right?
That's right. We'll send you a text to confirm.
Perfect. Well, I'll let you go. Thanks, Mia!

phrases.say: Hi, I'm returning your call from this morning.
phrases.not: I call you back because you called me.

mean.vi: Nói bạn đang gọi lại cho ai đó
mean.en: Say you are calling someone back

why.vi: "Returning your call" cho người kia biết ngay vì sao bạn gọi.
why.en: "Returning your call" tells them right away why you're calling.

phrases.say: Is now a good time to talk?

mean.vi: Hỏi xem người kia có tiện nói chuyện không
mean.en: Check if the other person can talk now

why.vi: Hỏi câu này trước tiên để tôn trọng thời gian của người kia.
why.en: Ask this first; it shows respect for their time.

phrases.say: Could you hold on a second?

mean.vi: Nhờ người kia chờ máy một chút
mean.en: Ask the person to wait on the line

why.vi: Không nói "wait me"; hãy nói "hold on" hoặc "wait for me".
why.en: Don't say "wait me"; say "hold on" or "wait for me".

phrases.say: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Which day?

mean.vi: Nói bạn nghe chưa rõ và hỏi lại đúng phần bị lỡ
mean.en: Say you missed something and ask about that part

why.vi: "I didn't catch that" lịch sự hơn "What?" và hỏi đúng chỗ cần.
why.en: "I didn't catch that" is polite and asks for the missing part.

phrases.say: Let me check and get back to you.

mean.vi: Hứa sẽ trả lời sau khi kiểm tra
mean.en: Promise an answer after you check

why.vi: "Get back to you" nghĩa là bạn sẽ gọi hoặc nhắn lại sau.
why.en: "Get back to you" means you will call or write later.

phrases.say: So that's Thursday at three, right?
phrases.not: Thursday three o'clock, correct or not?

mean.vi: Nhắc lại chi tiết quan trọng để chắc chắn
mean.en: Repeat key details to be sure

why.vi: Nhắc lại ngày giờ giúp tránh hiểu lầm; "…or not?" nghe hơi gắt.
why.en: Repeating details stops mistakes; "…or not?" sounds a bit rude.

phrases.say: Well, I'll let you go. Thanks again!
phrases.not: OK, I close the phone now.

mean.vi: Kết thúc cuộc gọi một cách ấm áp
mean.en: End a call in a warm way

why.vi: "I'll let you go" kết thúc cuộc gọi nhẹ nhàng, lịch sự.
why.en: "I'll let you go" ends a call in a kind, polite way.

ai.name: Mia
ai.role: a receptionist at a dental office
ai.goal: move the learner's appointment to a new time

roleplay.you: Return a missed call about your appointment, check the new time and end the call politely.

turns.a: Bright Smile Dental, this is Mia speaking.
turns.h: Hi, this is Alex. I'm returning your call from this morning.
br: Oh yes, thanks for calling back.

turns.a: We need to move your Tuesday appointment. Is Thursday at three okay?
turns.h: Could you hold on a second? Let me check… Yes, that works.

turns.a: So I'll change it to Thursday.
turns.h: So that's Thursday at three, right?

turns.a: We'll send you a text to confirm. Anything else?
turns.h: No, that's all. Well, I'll let you go. Thanks!

roleplay.end: Have a great day, Alex. See you on Thursday!
